answer: Make standing a slow-maturing relic: a new identity starts hollow, able to observe but earning nothing, and only after surviving many epochs of honest, graded work does its standing mature - like strata rising into a mesa, layer by layer, one epoch at a time. A clone farm faces the same wait for every identity, so a thousand clones need a thousand patient maturations, and a caught clone loses its whole relic, resetting to hollow. Time is the one resource an operator cannot clone in bulk, so patience itself becomes the sybil tax.
